object.description: Steps: Run BackupImporterTest. Expected: A restored workout equals the exported one; a saved workout is kept; a repeated import adds 0 workouts; a non-ZIP file, a ZIP without the JSON file, a truncated archive, one bad workout among good ones and a newer format version each add 0 workouts. This proves the restore logic only; the database and the messages are covered by PACE-STS-171.
